name: 90063 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90063 (Los Angeles) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (55% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90063 (Los Angeles) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
27% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
